chunks.text: It converts a near optimal expert policy into a set of constraints on the transition dynamics, and then clips a Bayesian posterior over the dynamics so that every sampled model yields a safe and high performing policy.

chunks.text: Beyond the method itself, the paper carefully analyzes when and why maximum likelihood estimation of the dynamics breaks down under uneven data coverage, and it shows how combining the constraints with uncertainty produces an informative ranking of actions in the states where the expert is unsure.

chunks.text: Given the rewards, an epsilon optimal expert policy, and the batch data, we use the closed form Bellman equations to write constraints that demand the value of actions the expert takes exceed the value of actions the expert never took.
